notes: Repricing: a full scan files cards to the cloud a few at a time instead of all at once, polls and cancels in chunks, and never wedges the pricing lane, so 778 cards land and the counter moves. Slabs: photos the bridge box collects now read as fresh, Reload waits up to three minutes with a visible counter and attaches the box's answer when it lands, and the panel messages wrap instead of pushing the sidebar. Stream: tap a chip in Benchmark and the app arms the box's stream overlay for that card, with the switch in Settings.
